theme_strategy: System-based preference (Light/Dark mode support). Defaults to Light mode as maps are traditionally easier to read outdoors, but provides Dark mode for nighttime navigation.

headings.usage: Location titles, Panel headers, Category names

body.usage: Descriptions, AI Q&A responses, News snippets (optimized for English and Chinese legibility)

colors.brand_primary: bg-zinc-900 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 dark:bg-white dark:text-black dark:hover:bg-gray-200

visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-2xl for primary panels, rounded-full for interactive controls and chips, rounded-xl for list items
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke on all floating panels (border-white/40 light, border-white/10 dark) to separate from map
visual_enhancers.map_tiles: Leaflet with OpenStreetMap. Consider using a muted/grayscale tile style or custom CSS filters on the map tiles to ensure the vibrant category markers stand out.

grids.system: Absolute positioning for map layout + Flexbox/Grid for panel contents.
grids.list_grid: grid-cols-1 for lists, gap-4 between items.

desktop.discovery_panel: fixed left-4 top-4 bottom-4 w-[400px] z-40 flex flex-col pointer-events-auto
desktop.search_bar: fixed top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 w-[480px] pointer-events-auto
desktop.map_controls: fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-40 flex flex-col gap-2 pointer-events-auto

mobile.search_header: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 z-40 pointer-events-auto
mobile.bottom_sheet: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 h-[60vh] rounded-t-3xl pointer-events-auto (use framer-motion)

motion.list_stagger: Framer motion staggered entrance for list items in the discovery panel
motion.bottom_sheet: Framer motion drag controls for mobile bottom sheet (drag='y')

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text inside glass panels passes APCA against map backgrounds
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='category-filter-food', data-testid='tts-listen-btn')
accessibility.aria: aria-hidden='true' on purely decorative icons. Descriptive aria-labels on icon-only buttons (like map controls)

media.image_constraints: object-cover, h-48 w-full on detail views, h-24 w-24 rounded-lg on list views
media.icons: lucide-react for all interface icons. Use clear, geographic-style iconography.

3d_libraries.map: Leaflet (react-leaflet). NOT 3D, but interactive 2D canvas. Used for the core spatial experience.

component_name: Shadcn UI (JavaScript/JSX). Do NOT generate .tsx files, use .jsx or .js
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure map occupies the background fully (`absolute inset-0`), and UI overlays map with high z-index and pointer-events-auto where clickable, pointer-events-none on containers to allow map interaction.
Use framer-motion for the mobile bottom sheet and desktop side panel transitions.
Implement Web Speech API for TTS reading the description in either EN or ZH based on current toggle.
Bilingual support: include a button to toggle descriptions between EN and 中文.
DO NOT use a completely transparent header/panel. All floating UI over the map MUST have backdrop-blur and a semi-solid background (e.g. bg-white/80).
Create dynamic marker icons in Leaflet by using custom HTML divs with Tailwind classes (rounded-full, bg-color, text-white) representing categories.
Use standard Leaflet via react-leaflet; no Google Maps keys needed.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or .js
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Adopt an 'optical clarity' glassmorphism style. The interface acts as a transparent lens over the physical world. Map content is the hero; UI is the minimal frame. Avoid heavy blocks of solid color. Prioritize legibility with high contrast typography against blurred backgrounds.
